author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಜಾತಜೀವಿಯ ಗುರಿಯು ಸುಖಬದುಕ ಹೊಂದುವುದು
ಚಾತಕದ ರೀತಿಯಲೆ ದಾರಿ ಕಾಯುವನು
ಜೀತಮಾಡುವನವನು ಜೀವನಕೆ ಸುಖಪಡಲು
ಕಾತರದಿ ಕಾಯುವನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The aim of every creature that is born is a happy life;
like the cātaka bird, he waits for the way;
he labours like a bonded servant to be happy in life,
and waits eagerly, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Every being longs for happiness. Like the cātaka bird that waits only for raindrops, we wait and toil for it, often at great cost.
